title: carthamus dentatus subsp. ruber
intro: Carthamus dentatus subsp. ruber, commonly known as Safflower, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family, characterized by its vibrant red or orange flowers and edible seeds. The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, making it useful in the treatment of various ailments such as cardiovascular diseases, cancer, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Safflower include reducing pain and inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents such as carotenoids, flavonoids, and polyphenols have been identified as the primary active compounds responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
